about: Monoliths may shrink, never grow: see tools/osd-size-budget.mjs. Every entry is a ceiling in physical lines; raising one needs a reason a reviewer agrees with.

go:abap.reason: ADT batch 1 (adt-i5 cases 1-7): Session message fields, classic exception binding, date/time and signed MOVE adapters, object-wrapper identity, STORE answer projection and conservative ADT host answers; timestamp conversion lives in go/timestamp. Includes the merged main baseline and the narrow UTF-16 adapter required to remove charsection dependency on abap.
